document: EIA Report: Bhatgaon Limestone Mine (fictional), Satna District, Madhya Pradesh

claims.quote: The total mine lease area is 142.6 ha, of which 98.4 ha is forest land.
The proposed lease covering an area of 162.6 ha falls in Survey of India toposheet 63D/10.
The nearest water body, Tons River, is located at a distance of 2.8 km (N) from the lease boundary.
Tons River flows at about 650 m north of the mine lease.
Total water requirement for the project is 45 KLD, sourced from groundwater.
Faunal species observed in the core zone include Indian Peafowl (Pavo cristatus) and Nilgiri Tahr (Nilgiritragus hylocrius).
